_about: Sample payloads for the Hall Pass notification contract (docs/NOTIFICATIONS.md). Use them as fixtures for parser tests. Every pushed message is {"MessageType": <name>, "Data": <object>}; the objects below are the Data part. A unit test (NotificationCatalogTests) fails when the catalog here and the real catalog differ, or when a sample is not an event the plugin can send. The values are made up.

HallPass.ScanFailed.Message: The scan failed: The operation has timed out.

HallPass.ApplyFailed.Message: An apply that started on 2026-10-14 at 19:02 UTC did not finish, probably because the server stopped. Tags it already wrote stay as they are; open History to see what it did and to undo it.

Data.Message: An apply that started on 2026-10-14 at 19:02 UTC did not finish, probably because the server stopped. Tags it already wrote stay as they are; open History to see what it did and to undo it.

Events.Title: A scan finished
Events.Description: Sent when a scan you started finishes, or when an automatic scan looked at 25 or more new or changed tracks. A few new tracks looked at quietly send nothing.

Events.Title: A scan did not finish
Events.Description: Sent when a scan failed or was cancelled before it was done.
Events.LockScreenText: A Hall Pass scan did not finish. Unlock for details.

Events.Title: Tags were written or put back
Events.Description: Sent when writing tags (Apply) or putting them back (Undo) finishes. Automatic writing after a scan sends this only when it changed 25 or more tracks.

Events.Title: Writing tags did not finish
Events.Description: Sent when writing or putting back tags failed or was cancelled, and when a job was found unfinished after the server stopped in the middle of it.
Events.LockScreenText: Hall Pass could not finish changing tags. Unlock for details.

Events.Title: More tracks are waiting for your review
Events.Description: Sent when the number of tracks waiting for you to decide goes up, at most once every 10 minutes.

Params.Name: MinCount
Params.Label: When this many tracks are waiting

Events.LockScreenText: Music is waiting for your review.
